reply: Thank you for telling us that your account is being closed after a check deposit was sent to the fraud department, and that the branch could not help. We understand how unexpected this was after many routine deposits. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please ask in writing for the reason for the closure and how your remaining balance will be returned, and keep a copy of the deposited check. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your new mortgage servicer drafted a $3,000.00 payment from your checking account that you did not authorize, after you had already paid. We are sorry this has left your account negative. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. You have the right to stop a company from taking automatic electronic payments, so please send your bank and the servicer a written notice revoking any authorization, and keep copies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the ATM returned your card without dispensing $200.00, yet the amount was taken from your savings account and your claim was denied. We understand the hardship this causes. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team, including the ATM records for that date. Please keep the ATM receipt if you have it, and if the bank does not own the ATM, contact the ATM owner as well. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you returned a $710.00 item using the merchant's prepaid label, that the return was delivered, and that your provisional credit was reversed after the merchant's response. We understand why you disagree with the outcome. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the return approval, the label and the carrier's delivery confirmation together, and ask in writing for the documents the decision relied on. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that your transfers changed from instant to delayed after years of normal service, and that you have not been given a clear reason. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team, including whether instant transfers can be restored. Please keep a note of the dates of your calls and of the first transfer that was delayed. Asking for the explanation in writing will help the review. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an order you never received was charged to your account, that the provisional credit was reversed, and that there are other charges you did not authorize. We understand this has left your account negative. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please list each charge you dispute with its date and amount, and keep any messages from the merchant and your dispute notices. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that information on your consumer reports has led to denials for bank accounts and housing, and that some disclosures were incomplete. We understand how difficult this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. You can dispute inaccurate items with each reporting company and also with the company that provided the information, and keep copies of every request and reply. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a monthly maintenance fee was charged to your daughter's account even though you were told at opening that it would be fee-free, and that the fee made the balance negative. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, including how the account was set up. Fees must be disclosed when an account is opened, so please keep any account opening documents and notes of what you were told. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your accounts were closed after they were hacked, that you were not told beforehand, and that the check for your remaining funds has not arrived. We understand how frustrating the mixed answers have been. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep the closure letter and a record of your calls, and ask in writing for the date and amount of the check being sent. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your account and routing number remain disabled even though you have documents showing the freeze has been lifted. We understand how difficult it is to be without access. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep a copy of the documentation from the comptroller and the date it was sent, and ask for written confirmation of what else, if anything, is needed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $1,200.00 retirement check drawn on the same bank has been placed on hold after you deposited it through the mobile app. We understand the financial strain this causes. Your complaint has been logged for review by the deposit operations team. Banks may use a different timetable for mobile check deposits, so please ask about the policy for your account and the exact date the funds will be available. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a $3,200.00 charge you did not make was made with your debit card, and that you reported it as soon as you were alerted. We understand how unsettling this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team alongside your existing dispute. Please keep the fraud alert text, your dispute details and a copy of your police report once filed. Only contact the bank through a number you trust. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that several rental charges were taken from your account without an itemized breakdown, and that your dispute was categorized in a way that did not reflect your concern. We are sorry your escalation call was disconnected. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please send a written notice that lists each charge, date and amount, and ask for the documents the merchant provided. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you paid $1,000.00 for what you were told was a vacation offer, that you tried to cancel within the cancellation period, and that your dispute was denied without an explanation. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep a copy of your cancellation request and the date you sent it, any sales documents, and your dispute and appeal notices, and ask in writing for the reasons for the decision. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the ATM did not dispense the $80.00 you requested, that the ATM operator said the cash would be found, and that your dispute was denied within hours. We understand how frustrating this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the ATM receipt and a note of your call with the ATM operator, and ask the bank what information it needs to reopen the dispute. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an extended hold was placed on a large cashier's check deposit and that you need the funds for a closing this week. We understand the time pressure this creates for you and your client. Your complaint has been logged for review by the deposit operations team, including the reason for the extended hold. Please ask for the hold notice in writing and the date the funds will be available, and review the bank's deposit hold policy. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you returned a damaged item three months ago, that you have not received the $120.00 back, and that your dispute did not succeed. We understand your frustration after providing your proof. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the return tracking, any messages with the merchant and your dispute notices, and ask in writing for the reason the dispute was closed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

We are very sorry for the loss of your mother. Thank you for explaining that her account is still open and being charged a monthly fee even though you provided her death certificate. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, including the closure of the account and the handling of the remaining balance. Please keep a copy of the death certificate and any documents showing your authority over her estate. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your business bill payments were switched from electronic transfer to mailed checks without your consent, causing late fees from your utility provider. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team, including the payment method and the second late fee. Please keep the late fee notices and a record of each request you made to restore electronic payments, and ask for written confirmation of the method being used. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your social security deposit was received by the bank but placed under a hold, and that you were not given a clear reason. We understand how important these funds are. Your complaint has been logged for review by the deposit operations team. Please keep the trace information from the social security office and ask in writing why the hold was placed and when it will be released. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a provisional credit for your debit card dispute was removed on the same day you were notified, and that you have not received the reasons for the denial. We understand your concern about how this was handled. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team, including the notice timing. Please ask in writing for the documents the decision relied on, and keep the notice you received. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a hold was placed on the $15,000.00 cashier's check you used to open your account, and that you were asked to leave the branch. We are sorry for how this visit went. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, including the treatment you describe. Please keep your deposit receipt and confirmation from the issuing bank that the check was valid, and ask in writing about the hold. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your merchant account was closed right after a $1,200.00 client payment, and that the funds are being held for 120 days. We understand the effect this has on your business. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, including the hold period. Please keep the invoice, the payment confirmation and the closure notices, and ask in writing for the reason for the decision and the release date. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a safe deposit box that used to be free is now charged to your account, and that you have been told it can only be closed in person at a branch you cannot travel to. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, including other ways to close the box. Please keep a record of your calls and the fee notices. You can ask the bank in writing what alternative closure options exist. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that more than $60,000.00 was taken from your account through many transactions you did not make. We understand how serious and distressing this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please list the transactions with their dates and amounts, keep a record of when you reported them, and file a police report if you have not already. Unauthorized electronic transfers carry added protections when reported promptly. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the amount offered when your CD matured did not match the redemption value in the letter you received, and that the payment was delayed while staff looked into it. Your complaint has been logged for review by the deposit operations team, including the interest calculation. Please keep the maturity letter and the email explanation you were given, and ask for a written breakdown of the redemption amount. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that funds were taken from your account without your authorization and that the investigation has gone on for more than 180 days. We understand how long this wait has been. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the screenshots of the transactions and a record of when you first reported them, and ask in writing for the current status and findings of the investigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that your account was closed after you turned the card autopay setting off and on, and that you were not given a reason. We understand how upsetting this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep the closure email and ask in writing how any remaining balance will be returned. A closed account can affect future applications, so you may want to check your checking account consumer report. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that someone posing as customer service gained access to your account, bought crypto and moved money. We are sorry this happened, and you did the right thing by making a police report. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep your police report and a record of the calls, and use only contact details from the company's official app or website. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your stimulus check deposits were held for a week each time, and how distressing that period was for you. We are sorry you felt you were treated differently. Your complaint has been logged for review by the deposit operations team, including your concern about fair treatment. Please note the approximate dates and amounts of each check, and keep any statements from that time. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
